mentions.name: Multilingual baby first words book
mentions.description: A multilingual first words book for a baby that pairs images with the same word translated into three languages, using AI-generated baby-friendly imagery. Created because no published books cover the family's specific mix of languages, and it also helps the author speak their mother tongue more naturally. The author offers to share the Canva file with others who want to make their own language-mix version.
mentions.problem: No published first words books cover the family's specific mix of languages.
mentions.audience: The author's own baby and family, plus other parents with a similar mix of languages who want to produce their own version
mentions.source_excerpt: I've been working on a multi-lingual first words book for a baby. None of the published books have our mix of languages (which is fair enough, I don't think there is much of a market for it!) and so I decided to create our own. It's just images and then the word translated into three different languages alongside it (like a typical first words book). I used Google's AI for the images, and it has done a surprisingly good job of creating baby friendly images, with enough detail to spark interest.
